backend/main.mo: Main backend canister with access control, user profiles, and full event CRUD using date ranges, sports arrays, and permission checks.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old single-date events to new dateRange format and adding sports array support.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected frontend files, components, and test requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file for build and analysis workflows.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining design tokens, light/dark theme variables, and global background/foreground styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file mounting the React app and loading the main TypeScript entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React entry configuring routing, authentication, profile setup, theming, and global app shell.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Displays an access-denied message with a prompt to log in.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Handles login/logout via Internet Identity with query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal requiring first-time users to save their profile name before accessing the app.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppBran: Displays the app icon and title in a centered branding header.
frontend/src/components/empty/EmptyState: Shows a placeholder image, title, description, and optional action button when no data is available.
frontend/src/components/events/DeleteEve: Confirmation dialog for deleting an event with cancel and delete actions.
frontend/src/components/events/EventForm: Form for creating or editing events with validation, sport selection, and voice input support.
frontend/src/components/events/VoiceInpu: Button that toggles speech recognition and parses recognized text into event form data.
Wraps the app with background styling, sync status bar, main content, and bottom navigation.
frontend/src/components/layout/BottomNav: Renders a fixed bottom navigation bar with links to main app sections.
frontend/src/components/status/SyncStatu: Displays online/offline status and pending sync count when necessary.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on user identity and invalidates queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useConnectivity.ts: Tracks online status and pending changes using browser connectivity events.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, identity persistence, and login/logout handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for loading, creating, updating, and deleting events and user profiles via the backend actor.
React hook wrapping browser speech recognition with start/stop controls and transcript state.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining theme CSS variables, dark mode values, and base styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, React Query, and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/AddEventPage.tsx: Page for creating events with autosaving drafts and submitting via useAddEvent.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarPage.tsx: Calendar view rendering events by date with month navigation and event indicators.
frontend/src/pages/EditEventPage.tsx: Page for editing an existing event, loading data then submitting updates.
frontend/src/pages/EventDetailsPage.tsx: Displays enriched event details with actions to edit, delete, or mark complete.
frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboard.tsx: Dashboard summarizing event metrics and showing quick actions for navigation.
frontend/src/pages/ImportFromSheetPage.t: React page for importing CSV data via URL or paste, mapping columns, previewing events, and submitting bulk upserts.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentsPage.tsx: Displays pending payments by month, calculates totals, and lists events with outstanding balances.
frontend/src/utils/bookingParser.ts: Parses free‑form text to extract event details such as sports, dates, times, organizer info, and requirements.
frontend/src/utils/csv.ts: Provides CSV parsing utilities including line parsing, header normalization, and column lookup.
frontend/src/utils/date.ts: Utility functions for formatting dates and navigating month and calendar structures.
frontend/src/utils/eventAdapter.ts: Converts backend Event objects to form data and back, extracting metadata, requirements, and computing totals.
frontend/src/utils/eventMetrics.ts: Computes event statistics including revenue, pending payments, upcoming events, and date-based filters.
frontend/src/utils/sheetEventMapping.ts: Maps CSV rows into Event objects, handling field extraction, date parsing, services parsing, and error reporting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL and session parameters, persisting them, and managing hash-based query params.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, container settings, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s current state, features, architecture notes, and known issues for the sports event manager app.
